metric_definitions.full_lpips: mean of full-resolution bilinearly upsampled LPIPS-Alex spatial map; not standard scalar LPIPS
metric_definitions.weighted_lpips: all-frame70/30 source-mask regional means of full-resolution LPIPS-Alex spatial map; empty-region weight reallocated
metric_definitions.full_dists: standard full-frame DISTS with all-ones feature-statistic weights
metric_definitions.weighted_dists: all-frame70/30 source-mask regional DISTS feature statistics; empty-region weight reallocated

scope: reference-guided static-rectangle development mechanism oracle; not automatic sender or confirmation
rate_basis: candidate complete packets versus complete native IVF anchors (including ROI signalling); full receiver coverage; same duration so byte scale cancels in BD-rate
promotion_limit: 10percent weightedDISTS plus corroboratingLPIPS is a development screen only; simplerROI/error selection and full/temporal outcomes must be reviewed; no population/neural-anchor claim
